concern_summary: Managing and clearing error states related to different payment methods, user wallets, and contact methods, ensuring that forms and processes can be reset and are ready for new inputs.

This concern addresses all functionalities related to managing and clearing errors associated with the avatar field and its URL for user accounts, ensuring that error states are consistently reset across different contexts.
Handling various types of errors associated with card and subscription transactions, including retrieving error messages, checking for card expiration errors, and logging subscription-related issues.
This concern deals with clearing error fields across multiple contexts to reset the error state, ensuring that errors are properly managed and visual feedback is accurate.
Configuring cursor style in response to the interactive state of components to enhance user experience and accessibility.
Management and updating of the cursor position during text input, including adjustments after text modifications and emoji handling to ensure proper user interaction.
This concern focuses on user profile management functionalities, including retrieving and displaying user personal details, avatars, and navigating related user profile interactions.

This concern addresses the user interface components related to error handling, specifically providing a way to inform users of a generic error and offering them recovery options such as refreshing the page or signing out, while ensuring the information is accessible through localized text.
